title: Lost Mary Nera15K Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava Prefilled Vape Pod
description: The Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod blends three exotic fruits for a bright, tropical vape. Tangy Kiwi adds sharpness, Passion Fruit brings sweet-sour depth, and Guava rounds it off with its soft, fragrant juiciness. A refreshing combination with plenty of complexity. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically keeps the pod topped up. Together, they deliver up to 15,000 puffs depending on use, with no messy refills or coil changes. Equipped with a 0.6ohm mesh coil, the pod ensures smooth vapour production and vibrant flavour throughout. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and continue vaping. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
